title: High-throughput screening for agonists of ROS production in live human vascular endothelial cells
protocol: Collect the cells from a 100-mm culture dish.
Rinse the cells with PBS(–).
Add 3 mL of 0.25% trypsin solution with EDTA.
Incubate at 37°C for 2–3 min.
Add 7 mL of the medium.
Strip the cells from the dish by tapping and gently pipetting.
Transfer the cells into a 50 mL centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge the cells at 450×g for 5 min.
Discard the supernatant.
Suspend the cells in the medium.
Count the cells in the suspension.
Seed approximately 1.0 × 10^4 cells into each well of a collagen-I-coated 96-well culture plate.
Culture the cells in each well with 200 μL of medium.
Incubate at 37°C under 5% CO2 for at least 16 hours.
Do not disturb the cells for at least 1 hour after seeding.
Discard the medium.
Add fresh medium.
Incubate at 37°C under 5% CO2 for at least 16 hours.
Set up the measurement protocol in CQ1 software.
To capture Hoechst 33342 staining, set a combination of 405 nm excitation wavelength and emission filter 447/60 in channel 1.
To capture WGA AF488 conjugate staining, set a combination of 488 nm excitation wavelength and emission filter 525/50 in channel 2.
To capture CellROX orange staining, set a combination of 561 nm excitation wavelength and emission filter 617/73 in channel 3.
Set the minimum exposure time for all channels.
Set the binning number of image resolution to 8.
Set 5 fields of view in a well.
Set a normal-focus 20× magnification lens.
Set the Z stack condition to 5 slice images with 3 μm steps.
Pretreat the cells with ROS inhibitors.
Incubate for 30 min at 37°C under 5% CO2.
Treat cells with each Test agonist.
Incubate for the appropriate time at 37°C under 5% CO2.
Treat the cells for the positive control group with LPS (1 μg/mL) 30 min before the end of incubation.
Load the cells with ROS fluorescence probe.
Mix CellROX orange (5 μM), WGA AF488 conjugate (0.01 mg/mL), and Hoechst 33342 (2 μg/mL).
Incubate for 30 min at 37°C under 5% CO2.
Capture fluorescence images with CQ1.
Wash the cells twice with HBSS(+).
Discard HBSS(+) from all wells.
Add fresh medium to all wells.
Place the 96-well culture plate into CQ1.
Set the power of the excitation lasers for channel 1 to the appropriate intensity.
Set the power of the excitation lasers for channel 2 to the appropriate intensity.
Set the power of the excitation lasers for channel 3 to the appropriate intensity.
Capture the fluorescence images.
Create an analysis protocol to detect cell nuclei from the maximum intensity projection image of Hoechst 33342 staining.
Create an analysis protocol to detect the whole cell area including one nucleus detected in step a, from the MIP images of WGA AF488 conjugate staining.
Analyze the MIP images of fluorescence staining using the created analysis protocols.
Extract the value of total fluorescence intensity of CellROX staining from the column titled "(Object 2) TotalIntensity CH3".
Extract the value of WGA AF488 conjugate staining area from the column titled "(Object 2) area".
If necessary, extract the value of the number of Hoechst 33342 stainings from the column titled "Count".
Calculate ROS production per cell area by dividing the total fluorescence intensity of CellROX staining per cell by the WGA AF488 conjugate-staining area per cell.
